criteria.rationale: Both deliverables accurately apply the operative approval status from the workspace registry and adhere strictly to the source materials without inventing unsupported facts. Specifically, the solver inspected workspace:registry.txt and identified that workspace:record-17.txt (revision 2, budget overage strictly greater than USD 5,000) is approved and in force, whereas workspace:record-22.txt (revision 3, USD 50,000, echoed in working-notes.txt and the working session summary) is an unapproved draft. Both the SOP and the Change Request Form enforce the operative USD 5,000 threshold, preserve all RACI roles, change criteria, approval sequences, and audit readiness rules from the working session summary, and clearly mark unprovided organizational details as placeholders to be confirmed or completed.
